data.name: Najah
data.gender_notes: Najah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Najah is derived from the Arabic word 'naja', which means 'to attain victory or triumph'. It symbolizes success, prosperity, and triumph over challenges. The name Najah carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najah usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that echoes the concept of achieving success and triumph in life, aligning with the Islamic values of striving for excellence.
data.etymology: Najah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Triumph.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
